$comment: Keyed to the gateway's actual config surface in omniroute/src/shared/utils/circuitBreaker.ts

perLegTimeout.comment: Seconds before a per-leg request is considered failed (default: undefined)

idleTimeout.comment: Seconds of inactivity before a connection is closed (default: undefined)

failureThreshold.comment: Number of failures before the circuit opens (default: 5)

resetTimeout.comment: Milliseconds to wait before attempting to reset the circuit (default: 30000)

halfOpenRequests.comment: Number of requests allowed in half-open state (default: 1)

degradationThreshold.comment: Failure count at which state becomes DEGRADED (default: 60% of failureThreshold)

backoffEscalationCount.comment: Number of open→half_open→open cycles before escalating backoff (default: 3)

rate_limit.comment: Milliseconds to wait before resetting after a rate limit failure

quota_exhausted.comment: Milliseconds to wait before resetting after a quota exhausted failure

rate_limit.comment: Number of rate limit failures before the circuit opens (default: 5)

quota_exhausted.comment: Number of quota exhausted failures before the circuit opens (default: 5)

cooldownAwareSkip.comment: Whether to skip requests during cooldown periods (default: false)
